init.description: Configure control mode (Cloud, Bluetooth Proxy, Hybrid), poll intervals, and face recognition key user names. Whenever a new face key is added, simply assign their name here without modifying any code.

session_taken.title: Smart Solity session taken over
session_taken.description:
Another device (such as the smartphone app) logged in with {email}, kicking Home Assistant out.

Solity allows only one active session per account. Invite a separate member account from the owner app and configure Home Assistant with that account.
